## ctxloom fragment show

Show fragment content

### Synopsis

Display the content of a specific fragment.

Reference format: bundle#fragments/name

Examples:
  ctxloom fragment show core#fragments/tdd
  ctxloom fragment show go-tools#fragments/testing

```
ctxloom fragment show <bundle>#fragments/<name> [flags]
```

```
  -d, --distilled     Show distilled version
  -i, --interactive   Review effective trust and offer to trust/blacklist (interactive terminal only)
```
